verdict.rationale: This product is an AI agent that drives an iPhone, so being able to plug in MCP servers as a client is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence mentions MCP or connecting external tool servers. The documented extension points are OpenAI-compatible model endpoints, editable prompts, and Siri/Shortcuts triggers, and none of these is an MCP client capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
